title: A new degenerated second main theorem for meromorphic mappings with hypersurfaces
summary: We establish a second main theorem with truncated counting functions for algebraically nondegenerate meromorphic mappings into a projective variety and a family of hypersurfaces in subgeneral position. The above bound of the total defect obtained from our result is better than that of the previous results. Moreover, in our result, the truncation level of the counting functions is estimated explicitly and independently of the number of hypersurfaces.
